name: awesome-gamedev-agent-skills
description: Make games with your AI coding agent: 79 game-dev skills and a router for Godot, Unity, Unreal, Roblox, three.js, Phaser and 6 more engines. Checked on the real engines.
readme: Make games with your AI coding agent, in the engine you already use. 79 skills for 12 engines: say what you're building, and a router loads the right 2 or 3 skills before your agent writes code. Agent Skills are small capability files an AI agent loads only when it needs them. This repo gives your agent 79 game-dev skills and a router that picks the right ones for you. You describe what you're building; the agent loads the matching engine and task skills before it writes code.
